ننشغل (form VII)
# نَنْشَغِلُ (nanšaḡilu) /nan.ʃa.ɣi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# نَنْشَغِلَ (nanšaḡila) /nan.ʃa.ɣi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# نَنْشَغِلْ (nanšaḡil) /nan.ʃa.ɣil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
